name: Bastion
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 hour
Components V, S, M (a one-inch square of granite, a similar cube of marble, and a diamond worth at least 75 gp)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one structure, 20 square ft./2 levels
Duration permanent
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell is designed to strengthen buildings. When cast, a soft glow spreads from your hands and flows across the wall until it envelops the entire structure. The glow is then absorbed into the building, leaving behind a faint, permanent sparkle to the stone, wood, brick or clay. The material’s hardness increases by 5, and its hit points are doubled. This is a permanent effect, and the target can receive the spell only once.
